key.name: kill-switch
key.description:
Emergency key that stops wgaf from synthesizing any further keyboard or mouse input. It only ever stops: pressing it again will not restart automation, because during a runaway script you should be able to lean on it. Run `wgaf release` when you are ready to allow input again.
The default is Escape on its own — easy to reach, universally understood as cancel, and not something you would confuse with an automation command.
This key is only captured while wgaf is running automation, and is released the moment it finishes. Between runs it reaches your applications normally.
While a run is in progress the key does belong to wgaf, so an application in the middle of being automated will not receive it. That includes a script pressing Escape itself: wgaf recognizes its own keystrokes and will not stop on them, but they will not reach the application either. Use the accessibility commands to dismiss a dialog from a script rather than pressing Escape at it.
